title: Non-contact Photoacoustic Imaging Empowered with PMUT Sensor and Refraction Correction
authors: Arijit Paramanick; Akshay Kumar; Antony Jeyaseelan; Deepayan Samanta; Rudra Pratap; Mayanglambam Singh
matched_query: non-contact photoacoustic imaging PMUT refraction correction beamforming acoustic optical imaging
reasons: authoritative metadata verified from Optica Early Posting
summary_en: A contact-free photoacoustic imaging system combining a MEMS piezoelectric micromachined ultrasound transducer, Snell's-law refraction-correction beamforming, and signal averaging. Phantom and tissue experiments report approximately 0.6 mm spatial resolution, 40 dB SNR, and 45 dB contrast at approximately 2.5 mm tissue depth.
metadata_verified_from: Optica Publishing Group / Optics Letters Early Posting

title: Re-thinking acoustic image enhancement across underwater sonar and medical ultrasound
authors: Taihong Yang; Yiqing Yao; Long Zhuang; Nuo Li; Tao Zhang; Shede Liu
matched_query: acoustic image enhancement underwater sonar medical ultrasound optical RGB-D simulation acoustic image denoising
reasons: optical RGB-D to acoustic benchmark simulation
summary_en: A unified acoustic-image enhancement framework spanning forward-looking sonar and medical ultrasound. It constructs high-fidelity acoustic benchmarks from optical RGB-D point clouds, simulates physically grounded noise, trains a teacher-student denoiser, and introduces an acoustic-specific no-reference evaluator.
